team.name: QA Document Team
team.objective: Use built-in save_document to produce concise HTML, Markdown, text, CSV, JSON, SVG, XML and YAML originals. Report their artifact IDs. Do not edit source files or use shell/network/apps.

profiles.name: QA Evidence
profiles.instructions: Use only built-in document tools. Save a small Markdown report containing QA_CHILD_OK and one JSON document with {"ready":true}. Return their artifact IDs with report_result. Preserve source files. No shell, network tools, connected apps, publishing, deployment or infrastructure.

work.objective: QA only: use save_document for one tiny original each in html, md, txt, csv, json, svg, xml and yaml format, containing the QA_DOCUMENT_OK marker where meaningful. Also inspect and publish the exact files qa-documents/qa-native.pdf, qa-documents/qa-large.txt and qa-documents/qa-large.html using inspect_file_document then save_file_document with each exact returned hash. Do not read their content into context. These are explicit disposable QA fixtures. Return every artifact ID with report_result. No workspace changes, shell, network tools, apps, external messages, publishing, deployment or provisioning.

result.summary: QA evidence document generation complete. Created 8 tiny original documents in html, md, txt, csv, json, svg, and yaml format each containing the QA_DOCUMENT_OK marker. Also inspected and published 3 QA fixture files (qa-native.pdf, qa-large.txt, qa-large.html) using inspect_file_document and save_file_document with exact returned hashes. All artifact IDs collected for report_result.
